name: Inline Keyboard
description: On-screen touch keyboard for DMS with fcitx5 candidates drawn in-keyboard. Optional: candidates and the input-method switcher need the separately built fcitx5 addon; the touchpad page needs the separately built dms-vtpad-helper (uinput); optional voice input shells out to fcitx5-vinput's CLI. Input-method switching goes through busctl (systemd) over D-Bus.
author: LilFishyChan
